notes.title: v0.2.5 update coming and new path for Caelum
notes.content:
Hi guys!

v0.2.5 will be out soon bringing a whole new mechanic for puzzles and a new (hopefully) exciting ending for the first leve.

I have also increased the grab radius on the controller so it's easier to grab stuff.

The Ring Door Puzzle has been tightened up and the lever pops back into place to stop the rotation when you let go.

Collision issues have been fixed where I've found them.

New area with the new mechanic is coming with this update!


As for the future of Caelum:

We are still trying to get a publisher on boart to speed up development by turning it full time. This will immensely increase production speed and hopefully the production value of Caelum!

Originally Caelum was meant to be this story driven exploration experience, but at the minute there is just not enough time to be put into proper lore and story design.

Combat in VR is really fun, and when I added the robot it became clear that we need more of this! 

I'm still not set on how I want to do the combat, but exploding potions sond fun to do. 

Thanks everyone who supporst us on this journey!

Cheers,
Adam

notes.title: Roadmap draft and game UPDATE
notes.content:
Hi guys!

I hope you are excited for the new content that is coming soon, if not you will by the end of this announcement. 

We are hard at work revamping the first island, getting new things in there and patching some issues.

We have akso started work in the second island and it's going to be Egypt themed! You'll be exploring an ancient tomb of an egyptian alchemist solving puzzles using the Shard you found at the end of the first island.

We are also building a new Hub island where you start the game and pick a level!

The third island is still a bit of time away, but we would like to know what places you want to see for the coming islands!

[b]Changes with the new update include, but not limited to:

-revamped visuals in the mine area and the library
-ugly building on hill changed for ruins
-optimised lighting
-major performance increase (!) [/b]
